newsitem.title: USA: U.S. "monoline" card companies seen sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. "monoline" card companies seen sharply higher.

text.p: Shares of "monoline" credit card issuers are likely to rise sharply in sympathy with the news Monday that Banc One Corp has agreed to acquire First USA Inc in a $7.3 billion deal, traders and analysts said.
First USA and other monoline companies mainly issue credit cards. First USA soared 11-1/4 to 48 in trading ahead of the New York Stock Exchange opening.
Among other monoline card companies, Advanta Corp rose 5-3/8 to 48-1/2. MBNA Corp and Capital One Financial Corp were also expected to soar.

Asked if Advanta, MBNA and Capital One would become takeover targets, analyst George Salem of Gerard Klauer Mattison said "In the market's mind they will." He said some bank which was not contemplating such a deal could take a fresh look after seeing Banc One's move.
